usedFor: Shopify holds the checkout and Front holds your shared inbox, so “Abandoned Checkout” can run “Create Contact”.

bestTemplate.name: “Abandoned Checkout” in Shopify, then “Create Contact” in Front
bestTemplate.why: A shopper who leaves at checkout becomes a Front contact, so your team can follow up from the inbox.

watchOut: “Abandoned Checkout” is polling, so the contact is created after a scheduled check, not when the shopper leaves.
